findings: Read-only isolated MySQL inventory found 32 active modules with published print templates but no PRINT draft action; #83 is a representative previously published module.
The new runtime guard requires PRINT in the current published module snapshot, so these older modules cannot print until a safe transition is performed.
The transition must preserve published version immutability and existing print jobs; the owner configuration and publish lifecycle remains authoritative.
next_exact: 以已发布模板但缺少 PRINT 动作的现存模块 #83 为代表，核对当前发布快照、模板和权限；设计并实施不破坏已有版本和数据的动作迁移/发布过渡，复验原打印路径、拒绝、页面和重启。
